en: A colorized vintage street scene showing a gently curving road lined with telegraph poles, detached houses with verandas and tin roofs, trees and a small garden area in the foreground with a red cylindrical post box. In the distance more low buildings and the shoreline are visible. Printed caption text at the upper right identifies the scene as a street in Lourenço Marques, Delagoa Bay.
